name: 789-hand-on-shoulder
notes: #789 B82.a beat 2 (new HandOnShoulder), v2 2026-11-27 (the user: the hand did not read from the fire's side): the elder sits at the fire, the partner side by side on the elder's left (0.11 u, both facing the fire). At 1 s the partner's near arm goes out sideways at shoulder height and lies across the elder's near shoulder (z 95, x 12, eased 0.8 s, held), the body leaning in (roll 10); the elder's left hand comes up over it (1 s, a soft hit as they meet); at 2.5 s the elder's other hand goes to a kid's head (not drawn here) and strokes once at 4.5 s; at 7 s the look up at the stars: the elder leans well back (lean -32, the head with the body) with the hands back on the seat (x -40), then the slow nod. Filmed from the family's front (the camera beyond the fire). Fire at the origin; the seat 0.28 u toward the camera. Every number [est] until the user signs off the clip.
